basis: PREREG_H1_TF A5.3.2 POWER-AND-YIELD, F2, F6.3/F6.4; Board A F6 review condition 5
outcomes_read: none: no TF-v1 window value, donor mean/noise, rotation, ladder, G3 or sealed outcome is read; only stored edit bytes, the base model and the G2 WikiText gradients

predictor.audits: A5.3.3 rotation and scaled-edit audits not computed (G3 staging outputs, F3); the NULL-SIZE payload's audit flags and masks are unchanged
predictor.contraction: wsp.features.response_field.contract (signed, fp32 per tensor), summed with math.fsum; an fp64 recomputation is recorded for the sign check

gradient_sources.base_field: root donors (predecessor = base): G2 base field (exact anchor); nonroot non-pick chain donors: G2 base field, flagged 'base-approximation-unvalidated' (F6.4)
gradient_sources.chain_exact: registered chain picks: F6.2 exact WikiText gradient at the actual predecessor

predictor.ladder: <g, bf16(W_pred + s * delta) - W_pred>, s in (0.25, 0.5); delta = raw stored delta (root) or realised increment (chain step)
predictor.rotation_seed: rotation_seed(canonical id): sha256('20261107:rotation:' + id)[:8] big-endian mod 2^63 (control_seeds.json rotation, A5.3.3)
predictor.shortcuts: equal block shapes within an edit share Haar frames (each tensor restarts the seeded generator state); rank_degenerate decided without SVD (unreachable for a finite nonzero block); both bitwise-equal to the registered functions (tests)
